abstract: The purpose of this technical recommendation is to define the display characteristics of subtitles for cinematographic works screened from digital cinema files (DCP, or Digital Cinema Package). This document supplements the provisions already set out in the standards ISO 26428-7 "DCDM Part 7 – Subtitle" and SMPTE ST 428-7:2014 "Digital Cinema Distribution Master – Subtitle", which describe subtitle source files.
details: French-language technical recommendation (original title: « Projection numérique – Sous-titres – Caractéristiques, dimensions et positionnement ») prepared by the CST Postproduction and Distribution–Exhibition departments; validated 24 June 2026, published September 2026 as a revision of CST-RT-028. Defines display characteristics of subtitles in DCPs: 2K/4K title-safe areas per aspect ratio, line count and positioning, characters per line, font handling, on/off timing and display duration, Interop and SMPTE XML formatting (incl. 3D and PNG subtitles), and SME (deaf and hard-of-hearing) subtitle colour coding. Complements ISO 26428-7 / SMPTE ST 428-7.
docTitle: Digital Projection – Subtitles – Characteristics, Dimensions and Positioning
